# Pablo Bueno

<div class="hero-lead">
I am a theoretical physicist and Professor Agregat at the Institute of Cosmos Sciences of the University of Barcelona (ICCUB). I work on black holes, gravitational theories beyond General Relativity, quantum field theory, entanglement and holography.
</div>

## Research

<div class="grid-cards">
<a class="card-clean research-link" href="research.html#black-holes"><h3>Black holes</h3><p>Regular black holes, collapse, interiors, extremality and the fate of spacetime singularities.</p></a>
<a class="card-clean research-link" href="research.html#higher-curvature-gravity"><h3>Higher-curvature gravity</h3><p>Einsteinian cubic gravity, generalized quasi-topological gravities and related extensions of General Relativity.</p></a>
<a class="card-clean research-link" href="research.html#entanglement-in-quantum-field-theory"><h3>Entanglement in quantum field theory</h3><p>Entanglement entropy, mutual information and universal constraints on quantum and conformal field theories.</p></a>
<a class="card-clean research-link" href="research.html#holography-and-quantum-gravity"><h3>Holography and quantum gravity</h3><p>Holographic entanglement, geometry, generalized symmetries and quantum aspects of gravity.</p></a>
</div>
